Meta.defaultDescription: A founder-led boutique crafting a handful of private jet roundtrips each year. Six to ten guests, hand-selected hotels, and Europe seen the way it was meant to be.

Home.heroSubtitle: A handful of journeys each year. Six to ten guests. Places that ordinary travel cannot connect — flown privately, lived intimately.
Home.introBody: ABATON was born from a private pilot's love of flying and roots in Europe's finest hospitality. We design only a few journeys each year, connecting regions that are difficult to combine through commercial travel — without long transfers, missed connections or compromise in comfort.
Home.pillar1Body: Every flight aboard a private jet, beginning and ending in Munich. No queues, no terminals — only the sky between one remarkable place and the next.
Home.pillar2Body: Six to ten guests. A journey that feels like travelling with friends who happen to have exquisite taste — never a tour, never a crowd.
Home.pillar3Body: Owner-led hotels with character, authentic tables, and cultural moments that are simply not open to everyone.
Home.howTitle: From first note to first flight
Home.step1Body: Tell us which edition speaks to you. We send a detailed, no-obligation brochure with the full itinerary.
Home.step2Body: We speak with you directly, answer every question and tailor the details around your party.
Home.step3Body: From the moment you reach Munich, everything is arranged. Flights, hotels, transfers and tables — all considered.
Home.closingTitle: A few seats. A whole continent.
Home.closingBody: Journeys are limited by design and fill quietly. If a season speaks to you, begin the conversation early.

Journeys.title: Journeys
Journeys.intro: Each edition is composed once and flown a single season. Below, the journeys currently open for enquiry.
Journeys.emptyState: New editions are in preparation. Please get in touch to be among the first to know.

JourneyDetail.requestBody: Receive the full brochure with detailed itinerary and pricing — with no obligation.
JourneyDetail.priceNote: Prices are per person and shared in your personal brochure.

About.title: Travel as it should feel
About.lead: ABATON JetJourneys is a founder-led boutique. We are not a large operator, and we never intend to be.
About.body1: The company was created by a private pilot with roots in Europe's luxury hospitality. Every journey reflects a personal vision of what true quality, authenticity and comfort can be when nothing is left to chance.
About.body2: We design only a small number of journeys each year, intentionally limited to six to ten guests. Each connects carefully selected regions that are difficult to combine through commercial travel and often require multiple flights, long transfers or compromises in comfort.
About.body3: We stay in hand-selected, mostly owner-led hotels with genuine character, enjoy authentic culinary experiences, and take part in cultural moments that are not open to everyone.
About.value1Body: A few journeys, done completely — never many, done partly.
About.value2Body: We choose places with a soul, not simply a star rating.
About.value3Body: Everything is arranged so you can be entirely in the moment.
About.ctaBody: Begin the conversation and discover the current edition.
